name: Zsh
summary: Z shell: default shell on macOS (since 10.15), programmable completion (compsys), ZLE line editor, themeable prompts, plugin ecosystem.
startupCostMs: Docs/community figures, not measured here: bare zsh with compinit ~20-50 ms; oh-my-zsh with several plugins and nvm commonly 300-1000+ ms; compinit without -C and duplicate compinit calls are the usual hot spots (zprof shows them).

windows.notes: No native Windows build. Available inside WSL (apt install zsh) or MSYS2 (pacman -S zsh); Git Bash does not ship zsh. Prefer bash (Git Bash), PowerShell or nushell for native Windows.

install.notes: macOS already ships /bin/zsh as the default shell; brew gives a newer build.

macos.notes: Terminal.app and iTerm2 start login + interactive shells: ~/.zprofile and ~/.zshrc both run. /etc/zprofile runs path_helper, which reorders PATH after ~/.zshenv; set PATH in ~/.zprofile or ~/.zshrc.

linux.notes: Terminal emulators start non-login interactive shells (only ~/.zshenv and ~/.zshrc). Change login shell with chsh -s $(command -v zsh).

prompt.notes: PROMPT/RPROMPT with %-escapes, precmd hooks; transient prompt via ZLE hooks (starship/p10k provide it).

line-editing.notes: ZLE built in; autosuggestions and syntax highlighting via zsh-autosuggestions / zsh-syntax-highlighting plugins.
